items.take: What looked like a minor camp knock five days ago is dragging on -- Steelers' top two WRs both sidelined heading into Week 2 of the preseason.

items.headline: Signed by the Raiders after two injury-marred seasons in Washington
items.take: Lands in one of the league's thinnest WR rooms behind Tre Tucker -- deep-league watch if he stays healthy, but injury history (35 games in 3 years) is a real red flag.

items.headline: Listed behind Rashod Bateman on Dolphins' first 2026 depth chart
items.take: Rookie is in the WR3/4 mix rather than a clear path to targets right away -- tempers immediate-impact hype, still one to track through camp cuts.

items.headline: UDFA rookie caught 2 TDs (incl. diving one-handed grab) in 17-7 preseason win over Seahawks
items.take: Standout preseason debut for a Georgia Southern UDFA — deep-league/dynasty stash to track through roster cuts

items.headline: NFL debut: 21-of-25, 190 yds, 2 TD (both to Dean Connors), 0 INT in 20-12 win over Chiefs
items.take: Electric preseason debut for the Rams' rookie signal-caller — a name to know in dynasty leagues.

items.headline: 7th-round rookie went 13-of-19 for 98 yards, played most of Chiefs' backup snaps
items.take: Extensive run behind Fields while Mahomes stays on a knee-surgery recovery pitch count.

items.headline: Signed as Mahomes insurance, went 4-for-4 in his first-quarter backup stint
items.take: Clean opener matters more if Mahomes' knee slows his Week 1 readiness.

items.headline: Took 80% of Browns' starter snaps, opened game with 3 straight carries
items.take: Clear early-down workhorse signal for Cleveland's rookie back.

items.headline: Threw an INT, was outplayed by Deshaun Watson in 34-10 preseason loss to Bears
items.take: Watson remains firmly ahead in Cleveland's QB competition after Week 1 preseason.

items.headline: Went 3-of-5 for 18 yards behind a patchwork line missing both starting tackles
items.take: Ugly debut with Ekwonu and Moton both out — don't overreact, but watch the OL news.

items.headline: Ruled week-to-week with hamstring strain, sat out Saturday's loss to Bills
items.take: Coach 'very confident' for Week 1, but monitor practice reports closely.

items.headline: UDFA rookie ran for 78 yards and the go-ahead 4th-quarter TD in 24-20 win over Saints
items.take: Strong second half after a slow start — pushing hard for a roster/practice-squad spot.

items.headline: Made Vikings debut, went 2-of-3 for 10 yards on lone series in 13-10 win over Giants
items.take: Small sample in his first game as Minnesota's new QB1 — chemistry still building.

items.headline: Played most of the first half at Giants, went 4-of-7 for 34 yards as Vikings' QB2
items.take: Solid enough to muddy the QB2 battle — trade rumors haven't gone away, though.

items.headline: 4 catches, 51 yards, including a one-handed TD grab from Carson Wentz vs. Giants
items.take: Standout showing in a crowded Vikings WR room behind Jefferson — deep-league watch.

items.headline: Practiced in a red no-contact jersey pregame but sat out the preseason opener
items.take: Trending toward a Week 1 return from his ACL tear, per Harbaugh — confirm next practice.

items.headline: Took a scary hit and visited the medical tent, then returned to throw a 15-yard TD
items.take: Passed the concussion check and finished 3-of-4, 26 yards, 1 TD — worth tracking his next reps.

items.headline: Ruled out at least a week with an ankle injury from his 58-yard preseason debut
items.take: No long-term prognosis yet; keeps James Conner firmly in the early-down mix.

items.headline: Played 100% of Tua Tagovailoa's snaps as Falcons WR2 in preseason opener vs. Broncos
items.take: Locks in as Atlanta's clear No. 2 receiver opposite Drake London, ahead of Olamide Zaccheaus.

items.headline: All 4 of Tua Tagovailoa's targets on the opening series went to Pitts (3 catches, 22 yards) vs. Broncos
items.take: Clear first read early with Drake London playing just 2 snaps and Bijan Robinson resting -- strong TE1-range signal.

items.headline: Tore his ACL in Thursday's preseason opener vs. Chargers, needs season-ending surgery
items.take: No standalone fantasy value, but leaves Houston with just two healthy QBs on the roster.

items.headline: Led all Colts pass-catchers with 6 catches on 7 targets for 80 yards in 13-13 tie vs. Patriots
items.take: Standout usage behind Anthony Richardson's clean half in a Colts TE room without a clear-cut starter.

items.headline: 7 catches on 8 targets for 63 yards, all in the first half of preseason win over Titans
items.take: Camp buzz turns into real production -- with Pearsall out for the year and Kirk banged up, he's carving out Year 1 FLEX appeal.

items.headline: Rough preseason debut with Falcons: 3/5 for 22 yards (70.4 rating), fumbled a shotgun snap in 17-0 loss to Denver
items.take: Shaky first look at Atlanta's new QB1 job after leaving Miami -- not a panic move yet, but worth watching the rest of preseason.

items.headline: Went 4/5 for 43 yards passing plus 2 carries for 9 yards on Dolphins' lone starters' drive in 16-13 preseason win
items.take: Clean, efficient first look as Miami's new QB1 after taking over for the departed Tua.

items.headline: Rookie 4th-rounder impresses in NFL debut: 5/7 for 56 yards, leads Jets to a 10-0 lead with Geno Smith (sore foot) resting
items.take: Strong debut strengthens his case in the Jets' backup QB competition over Bailey Zappe and Brady Cook -- dynasty stash.

items.headline: Breaks a 31-yard TD run in the first quarter of Jets' preseason opener vs. Buccaneers
items.take: Early explosive-play flash as he looks to hold off the rest of New York's backfield for touches.

items.headline: Could return to practice as soon as late next week, per Matt LaFleur
items.take: Upgrade from the prior 'out at least this week' groin-injury framing -- trending toward a normal Week 1 timeline.

items.headline: Full practice participant Thursday; McVay says WR is 'ready to roll' for Week 1
items.take: Groin/psoas scare from last week's joint practice has resolved -- no reason to downgrade him in drafts.

items.headline: Preseason debut: 11 carries for 58 yards, 3 catches for 14 yards, 24 of 30 snaps before exiting
items.take: Outsnapped Tyler Allgeier 24-6 in their shared run -- clear lead-back workload, draft him as a starter, not a committee back.

items.headline: Worked into first-team reps opposite Chase/Higgins in preseason opener, passing Mitchell Tinsley in the slot competition
items.take: Big-bodied 4th-round rookie is winning the Bengals' WR3 job in one of the NFL's best passing offenses.

items.headline: Preseason debut: 10-of-13 for 153 yards, 3 total TDs (2 pass, 1 rush), 154.8 rating in 28-9 win over Packers
items.take: Dominant debut behind Rudolph/Howard adds real intrigue to Pittsburgh's post-Rodgers QB picture -- dynasty stash.

items.headline: 4 catches for 51 yards on 5 targets, working with the 1s in place of injured Metcalf/Pittman
items.take: Second-round rookie flashed real YAC juice in his debut -- deep-league/best-ball stash if the role sticks.

items.headline: 31-yard catch from Davis Mills on Texans' opening drive, limited to one series in preseason opener
items.take: Early rapport with Mills in a Texans TE room without a clear-cut starter -- late dynasty TE to monitor.

items.headline: 2 rushing TDs and a 55-yard catch in 27-7 preseason win over Texans
items.take: Explosive plays behind the Chargers' RB1 make him a very late-round dynasty/best-ball flier.

items.headline: Went 23/30 for 295 yards, 3 TDs (140.3 rating) plus 44 rush yards in 37-24 preseason win over Titans
items.take: Sharp, extended look with a reshuffled WR room (Pearsall out) -- good early sign for SF's passing game.

items.headline: Caught 8 passes for 88 yards and a TD in preseason opener vs. Titans
items.take: Heavy target share early with Pearsall out for the year -- TE1 role looks unchanged.

items.headline: Caught 2 TDs (3 rec, 37 yards) in preseason win over Titans
items.take: Direct beneficiary of the Pearsall injury -- WR2 stock climbing fast in Purdy's offense.

items.headline: Carried 22 times for 73 yards and a TD plus a catch in preseason opener vs. Titans
items.take: Unusually heavy preseason workload for a starter -- encouraging health/workload signal after 2024's injury issues.

items.headline: Threw for 170 yards and 2 TDs, including a 34-yard score to rookie TE Gunnar Helm, in preseason opener
items.take: Efficient extended look in Year 2 -- early chemistry with a new-look pass-catching group.

items.headline: Rookie TE caught a 34-yard TD from Cam Ward in preseason opener vs. 49ers
items.take: Early camp-to-game chemistry with Ward -- worth a dynasty/TE-premium watch.

items.headline: Went 11/14 for 145 yards with a rushing TD (6 car, 53 yards) in his half of preseason opener vs. Patriots
items.take: Strong per-play efficiency continues to build his QB1 case even after a fumble and a deflected INT; Daniel Jones sat out all preseason.

items.headline: Caught a 13-yard TD from Kirk Cousins on the Raiders' first-team opening drive vs. Cardinals
items.take: Early rapport-building rep with the starting QB -- positive signal for his TE1 role in Vegas.

items.headline: Rookie WR flashed speed and route-running, including a 19-yard grab from Fernando Mendoza
items.take: Deep-league/dynasty stash watch after a strong preseason debut.

items.headline: Named starter for tonight's preseason opener vs. Patriots, will play entire 1st half
items.take: Riley Leonard gets the 2nd half as Daniel Jones (Achilles) sits out all preseason -- extended look at Richardson's roster case.

items.headline: Updated depth chart has him starting at slot WR tonight with Metcalf and Pittman both out
items.take: Continued 1st-team reps and a punt-return role now project into a real game look -- deep-league/best-ball stash.

items.headline: Promoted to Browns' first-team offense, catches back-shoulder TD from Watson in practice
items.take: Camp buzz is translating into real reps alongside Jeudy/Concepcion -- strengthens his rookie fantasy case.

items.headline: Trade rumors (Jets, Panthers, Browns speculated) swirl after losing Vikings' QB1 job to Murray
items.take: Says he wants to stay in Minnesota, but a trade before cutdowns would reset his fantasy outlook with a new team.

items.headline: Trading 1st-team series with Allgeier and flashing as a receiver, but Hackett downplays the hype
items.take: Real receiving flashes, but OC still frames Conner as the starter -- don't overpay in redraft yet.

items.headline: Strained hamstring Wednesday, already back at practice Thursday
items.take: No lasting concern for the depth piece competing for scraps behind Travis Kelce.

items.headline: Named Browns' starter for Saturday's preseason opener vs. Bears; Sanders starts Week 2
items.take: First live game action since 2024 -- small edge in the QB battle, though Monken says the competition stays open.

items.headline: Will start Browns' 2nd preseason game (Aug. 22 vs. Bills) after Watson gets the Week 1 exhibition nod
items.take: Split starts keep the QB battle alive into the summer's final stretch -- don't price in either QB's Week 1 job yet.

items.headline: Named Falcons' starter for their preseason opener vs. Broncos
items.take: First real signal in Atlanta's QB race, but Stefanski stresses it's preseason-only -- Week 1 still unresolved.

items.headline: Not yet cleared for full 11-on-11 work as Tua gets the Falcons' preseason-opener start
items.take: ACL rehab pace, not merit, is driving Atlanta's QB pecking order right now -- watch for his practice status to escalate.

items.headline: Left Wednesday's joint practice vs. Jets with a minor toe injury
items.take: Not considered serious, and Bucs starters were expected to see limited snaps in Thursday's opener anyway.

items.headline: Still limited to individual drills, but Harbaugh says team drills could come as soon as next week
items.take: Recovery pace keeps trending toward a Week 1 return off the torn ACL.

items.headline: Missed Tuesday's practice with undisclosed injury, questionable for Thursday's opener
items.take: Not seen as serious, but Steelers' top two WRs both banged up at once is worth tracking before Week 1.

items.headline: Missed back-to-back practices with a right leg injury, questionable for Thursday's opener
items.take: Not considered long-term, but paired with Metcalf's absence it clouds the Steelers' WR room right before their opener.

items.headline: Returned to full practice Tuesday after missing time with a toe injury
items.take: LaFleur said the toe issue isn't long-term — good sign for the Round 1 WR heading into Year 2.

items.headline: Battling an ankle injury, may sit Thursday's opener as a precaution
items.take: Not considered long-term; still on track for Week 1 vs. Minnesota.

items.headline: Named Vikings' Week 1 starting QB over J.J. McCarthy
items.take: Locks in as a streaming-caliber QB1 with Justin Jefferson now that O'Connell has settled the summer-long battle.

items.headline: Officially the backup after losing Vikings' QB1 competition to Kyler Murray
items.take: Dynasty stash only for 2026 -- no Week 1 fantasy relevance behind Murray.

items.headline: Out 'at least this week' with groin injury, will miss Thursday's preseason opener
items.take: Escalation from last week's 'not long-term' framing -- MarShawn Lloyd steps into 1st-team reps in his place.

items.headline: Getting 1st-team preseason reps with Josh Jacobs out (groin)
items.take: Real short-term handcuff value if Jacobs' absence extends beyond this week.

items.headline: Emerging as Steelers' early-down RB1 over Jaylen Warren through 4 practices
items.take: Slight lean toward Dowdle in early drafts, though Pittsburgh is still expected to run a real committee.

items.headline: Left Rams-Cowboys joint practice early with groin soreness, described as minor
items.take: Low concern per Rapoport, but worth a glance before Thursday's practice given his WR1 profile.

items.headline: Drawing 'clear new No. 1 receiver' buzz even as Jeudy remains the named starter
items.take: Strong best-ball/dynasty stash as camp hype keeps building for the 2nd-round rookie.

items.headline: Still holding a top-3 WR spot through 6 Raiders practices, staff calls him 'a steal'
items.take: Deep-league/dynasty value continues to build behind Tre Tucker and Jalen Nailor.

items.headline: Reportedly looked faster/more explosive than Trey Benson in head-to-head camp look
items.take: Still behind Tyler Allgeier on the depth chart but keeps closing the gap in a crowded RB room.
